description: Rescue an existing .pptx (or legacy .ppt with LibreOffice installed) into AI-readable unPaper HTML: content, tables, notes, chart DATA, image placeholders + a facts file. Use when asked to redesign, update, or 'un-paper' an existing PowerPoint. Then rewrite the returned deck.ai.html into a proper deck (keep every <figure data-unpaper-image> placeholder), call `rehydrate`, then `check` + `convert`.

outDir.description: directory for outputs (default: alongside the input)

name: import
